mathematical_meanings: Left image: The dashed line aligns the peak with its output value of 900. Right image: The dashed line reads off the output 12 at x = 5.
Rationales: In both images the feature connects a feature of the graph to its vertical-axis value. The dashed horizontal segment from 900 to the graph’s peak. The dashed horizontal segment joining the sloped graph to the y-axis at 12.
